mapper.select: SELECT turn.request_id, turn.conversation_id, turn.execution_id, turn.question, turn.answer, turn.status, turn.error_code, turn.accept_before FROM agent_turn turn JOIN agent_conversation conversation ON conversation.id = turn.conversation_id WHERE turn.execution_id = #{id} AND conversation.owner_key = #{owner}
SELECT count(*) FROM agent_turn turn JOIN agent_conversation conversation ON conversation.id = turn.conversation_id WHERE conversation.owner_key = #{owner} AND turn.quota_at > #{cutoff}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO agent_turn (request_id, conversation_id, question, answer, status, accept_before, quota_at) VALUES (#{turn.requestId}, #{turn.conversationId}, #{turn.question}, #{turn.answer}, #{turn.status.code}, #{turn.acceptBefore}, #{turn.quotaAt}) ON CONFLICT (request_id) DO NOTHING
